title: Admissions Open for Session 2026-27
content: Admissions are now open for Nursery to Class IX and Class XI. Please visit the school office or apply online.

title: Summer Vacation Schedule
content: The school will remain closed for summer vacations from May 20th to June 30th. Classes will resume on July 1st.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM)
content: A PTM for classes I to XII will be held on Saturday, August 10th, from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
